allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: NTPC Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of unsecured non-convertible debentures of Rs.4,000 crore on 17.06.2025, through private placement at a coupon of 6.89% p.a. for a tenor of 10 years 1 day, maturing on 18.06.2035.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: NTPC Limited has informed the Exchange about "NTPC has decided to issue unsecured non-convertible debentures of Rs.4,000 crore on 09.05.2025, through private placement at a coupon of 6.84% p.a. for a tenor of 10 years, maturing on 09.05.2035."
